```yaml
name: DCO Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  dco-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Run DCO check
      id: dco-check
      run: |
        git log --pretty=format:"%h %an <%ae> %s" | grep -qE '.*[Ss][Ii][Gg][Nn]-[Oo][Ff][Ff]: .*$' || echo "::error::DCO sign-off is required. Please add a line like 'Signed-off-by: Your Name <your.email@example.com>' at the end of each commit message."

    - name: Fail if DCO check failed
      if: ${{ steps.dco-check.outputs.summary == '::error::DCO sign-off is required. Please add a line like '\''Signed-off-by: Your Name <your.email@example.com>'\'' at the end of each commit message.' }}
      run: exit 1
```
